title: Replace stop-start write-off thresholds with a permanent investment deduction
action: Instead of raising and lowering the instant asset write-off threshold from year to year, give all firms a permanent, predictable deduction for new investment: either through a net cash-flow tax or, as a simpler option, partial immediate expensing of new capital with a matching cut to interest deductions.
why: Temporary write-offs pull investment forward and favour small, low-value assets. A permanent deduction lowers the cost of capital for all investment, so firms invest in the equipment that best lifts their productivity.

evidence.source: Creating a more dynamic and resilient economy: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: The preferred approach would involve partial immediate expensing of new capital combined with a counterpart reduction in interest deduction.

evidence.source: Creating a more dynamic and resilient economy: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: moving towards a system that promotes investment by reducing the tax on normal returns.

evidence.source: Australia's Future Tax System: Report to the Treasurer, Part One (Henry review)
